title: Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones
abstract: arXiv:2611.18916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. translated_title: 简化、求同、蒸馏：基于“垫脚石”的无标签自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 能否让语言模型在没有标签的情况下自学推理？在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将模型自身用作教师，但需要借助真实答案来强化这个教师。最自然的无标签替代方案——对模型自身的多次尝试进行投票——恰恰在难题上失效：各次尝试彼此意见不一，且最常见的答案往往是错误的。我们提出 STONE，一种无标签的替代方法，它将“一致性检验”转移到更容易的相关问题上。模型自行编写这些“垫脚石”问题，保留它能一致求解的那些问题，并将附有解题过程的完整推导展示给教师（但移除最终答案）；学生则只能看到原始问题。整个过程中没有任何步骤使用标签，推理时也不需要额外的上下文或额外的模型调用。在五个数学基准上，所提出的方法在思考模式下为 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 取得了最高的平均准确率。在不使用思考模式的情况下，它分别提升了 13.2 和 22.7 个百分点，达到使用真实答案的 OPSD 增益的 2.5 倍和 2.7 倍。
tldr: 提出 STONE 方法，让模型自行生成并一致求解更简单的“垫脚石”问题作为教师示范，实现完全无需标签的自蒸馏，在五个数学基准上超越了使用真实答案的 OPSD。
en_tdlr: STONE enables label-free self-distillation by having the model generate easier "stepping stone" problems it can solve consistently and use their worked solutions as teacher demonstrations, achieving the best average accuracy on five math benchmarks and outperforming OPSD that relies on ground-truth labels.
